newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures hold on pool price floor.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures hold on pool price floor.

text.p: Australian wheat futures overcame early weakness to trade on relatively healthy volumes in near-term contracts on Friday.
November 1996 fell by A$4.50 a tonne to A$146.00 on 22 trades, while January 1997 sold steady on A$148.50 on 23 trades.
January 1997 options also traded, with two A$150.00 calls selling at A$5.50 and five A$140.00 puts at A$2.00.
Early weakness reflected Chicago's overnight fall but found good support from the pool price floor of about A$137.00 a tonne, Ed Scamps of Elders Risk Management Pty Ltd said.
Scamps sees the prospect of further weakness as Argentina, Australia and Canada begin to sell wheat on the world market.
The recent futures rally had only limited potential upside and strong international competition could further depress prices with A$144.00 for January 1997 a possibility, he said.
